messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — hitting a weird accuracy reg when combining SmoothQuant + activation-clipping (act-clip) with AWQ on 70k+ contexts. baseline fp16/aq runs fine. details below.

Alejandro: can you paste the eval numbers? p99 or rouge/accuracy diffs?

Maya: small table from the holdout eval (LM perplex/EM):
- fp16: ppl 12.3, em 0.842
- awq+smoothquant (no actclip): ppl 12.7, em 0.838
- awq+smoothquant+actclip: ppl 15.4, em 0.801

Sophia: whoa, that's a big EM drop. Is this tied to KV cache length or attention matmul rounding?

Maya: suspect kvcache eviction/prefetch with long prefix. If sequence > 65k we see divergence. Logs show repeated WARN: "kv_cache_mismatch at step=7" and attention perf falling back to CPU for block 0.

Kenji: can you attach the debug run (small repro)? also which kernel backend? cuda/cutlass or triton?

Maya: ran on dedicated-gpu-4, backend=triton_v2. repro script:
```
python run_eval.py --model redwood/ulm-13b --quant awq --smoothquant true \
  --actclip 1.5 --max_seq 70000 --batch 1 --kvcache_prefetch true
```

DevBot: deploy-log: job 4521 started on dedicated-gpu-4 at 2025-06-11T13:12:03Z

Ravi: quick thought — actclip is channel-wise scaling that could amplify quant error if KV keys get prefetch-shifted. Try lowering actclip to 1.1 or enable per-channel smoothscale.

Maya: tried 1.1 -> ppl 13.0 em 0.833 (better). Also tried actclip + disable kvcache_prefetch -> ppl 12.9 em 0.835.

Alejandro: so prefetch interacts badly. Maybe prefetch is misaligned with block granularity for longctx, causing stale kvs to be used during matmul -> quantized accumulation error.

Sophia: file a mini-ops issue? and add a targeted unit test that steps through kv prefetch boundaries (e.g., 65536, 65537, 66000) with and without actclip.

Maya: filing now — https://redwood.internal/issue/ML-1729 (WIP). Also attaching a 20-line diff of the runtime guard I used:
```
+ if (kvcache_prefetch && seq_len > KV_BLOCK_SZ && backend==triton) {
+   // disable aggressive prefetch for act-clip kernels
+   kvcache_prefetch = false;
+ }
```

Kenji: good quick patch. We should instrument mismatch counts (per-layer) and export to console metrics (kvmismatch.count, kvmismatch.layer).

Ravi: for the quant bakeoff notes — baseline AWQ tends to have lower memory but sometimes fp8 fallback in attention improves numeric stability. Could try AWQ+fp8-attn-fallback as a policy.

Maya: ran that: awq + fp8-attn-fallback + smoothquant + actclip=1.3 -> ppl 12.6 em 0.840 (close to baseline).

Sophia: action items:
- Maya: record a minimal repro and add to model onboarding checklist (due EOD)
- Kenji: add kvmismatch metrics + unit tests (MR)
- Alejandro/Ravi: run a 4-model bakeoff (AWQ / AWQ+SQ / AWQ+SQ+actclip / AWQ+SQ+fp8fallback) across [16k,64k,96k] and report EM deltas

Maya: thanks all :pray: adding eval configs to shared bucket (s3://redwood-ml-evals/smoothquant-actclip-2025-06-11)

DevBot: job 4521 completed with exit=0 (reports uploaded)

Alejandro: ping me when results land, I'll draft a short note for release channel outlining the runtime guard and recommended actclip defaults for longctx.

Maya: will do. closing thread for now, will update issue ML-1729 with final numbers.
